summary: A survival base-building log wall module, 3.0 m long x 3.0 m tall x 0.3 m thick: ten tapered round logs stack… options tier; sockets socket_join_left, socket_join_right, socket_top.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.base_wall_wood or place "prefab": "base_wall_wood" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
